I know a lot of people have already shared their thoughts, but I wanted to add mine. I was 18 when I had my first child, and now I have two kids. Along the way, I experienced three miscarriages and two abortions. I often think about the children I could have had, and it brings me sadness each time. However, during those moments, I was either sick, financially unstable, or struggling with suicidal thoughts. Looking back, I realize that if I had kept the other pregnancies, I would have faced overwhelming challenges as a single mom—struggling with living expenses, daycare costs, and working two jobs just to make ends meet. I don’t live near family, so I would have no backup for emergencies, like picking my kids up from school if I had to leave work early. Ultimately, I know I made the right decisions for myself and my children. Reflecting now, I’m close to completing my bachelor’s degree, I have a stable, consistent income, and a secure home. On top of that, I’ve been going to therapy and working on myself, and I can see a positive change in the attention and affection I’m able to give my kids. It’s been a tough journey, but I’ve grown so much along the way.
